declarations.full_header: theorem foundationComponentAction_naturality {M N : A.FoundationRightModule Q} (f : M ⟶ N) {i j : Q.Vertex} (a : A.Hom (i.val : ℤ) (j.val : ℤ)) (x : (A.foundationRightEvaluation Q j).obj M) : (f.hom.app i).hom (A.foundationRightComponentAction Q M a x)= A.foundationRightComponentAction Q N a ((f.hom.app j).hom x)
